summary.text: Chris Fugate is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 84 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes work with the Kentucky State Police and as a pastor.

paragraphs.text: Chris Fugate was born in Chavies, Kentucky.
His career experience includes working with the Kentucky State Police and as a pastor, and he has been a member of the Project Hope Boys & Girls Club.
Fugate took office in the Kentucky House in 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations and Revenue Committee, the Natural Resources and Energy Committee, the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee, and the Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.
